body.description: Analytics Finder (`q=analytics`) campaign-delivery response: the discovery call of the live demographic-segment fallback (connector `analytics_segments`, `_delivering`). One request per ad account and preset window: `pivot=CAMPAIGN`, `timeGranularity=ALL`, the exact window of the segment request and the `accounts` facet, projecting only `pivotValues` and `impressions`. The connector sends it only after LinkedIn 202609 rejected the contracted Statistics Finder request (`ad_analytics_statistics.json`) with HTTP 400 (observed live on 2026-10-07: '"MEMBER_SENIORITY" is not an enum symbol'); it then reads each campaign with impressions through `ad_analytics_member_segments.json`, and the discovery result is shared by the three demographic pivots of one window. A campaign reported with zero impressions has no demographic values and is skipped. The simulator answers the contracted Statistics Finder form, so simulated runs take this request only when a world fault rejects that form with HTTP 400. Sources: the Ads Reporting page at reference_url (served moniker li-lms-2026-09, ms.date 2026-06-19, updated_at 2026-06-24) for the Analytics Finder, its sample response and its limits; the Reporting schema page (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/ads-reporting-schema?view=li-lms-2026-09; served moniker li-lms-2026-09, ms.date 2026-09-14, updated_at 2026-09-16) for the query parameters, the Analytics Finder `pivot` enum, which lists CAMPAIGN, and the metric types. Request conventions: url is relative to https://api.linkedin.com/rest/; {acct} is urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A{id}; Rest.li parentheses, colons and commas stay literal; {fields} must equal request.fields exactly, which equals `client.SEGMENT_DISCOVERY_FIELDS`, and is sent raw (LinkedIn rejects an encoded projection with 400). `dateRange.start`, `timeGranularity` and at least one facet are required; `pivotValues` is a response field requested through `fields`, never a filter. Limits (reporting page): up to 20 fields; at most 15,000 elements per response; the endpoint does not paginate and the client follows a rel=next link only when one is returned; a response at the cap without one makes the segment listing incomplete with the reason "result limit reached". An empty `elements` means no delivery in the window or no read access. documented_sample is the Reporting page's Analytics Finder sample response, verbatim and identical to ad_analytics.json's (q=analytics, pivot=MEMBER_COMPANY, timeGranularity=DAILY, two elements, each pivotValues a single urn:li:organization value); the page publishes no Analytics Finder sample for this exact pivot and granularity, and no sample is invented.

elements.description: Report data points, one per campaign with activity in the window; at most 15,000 per response.

items.description: One campaign over the whole requested window (`timeGranularity=ALL`). Only `pivotValues` is required; an absent metric is unavailable, never zero.

pivotValues.description: Values of the requested pivot (string[]). For this request: exactly one campaign URN, urn:li:sponsoredCampaign:{id}; the connector rejects any other form as a defect. The documented sample pivots by MEMBER_COMPANY and so carries an organization URN.

impressions.description: long. The campaign's impressions over the window; a campaign with 0 is skipped by the fallback.

dateRange.description: Not in this request's projection, so absent from live responses; declared because the documented sample carries it. UTC calendar days, start and end inclusive. The schema page marks start required and end optional.

start.description: Calendar date; year, month (1-12) and day (1-31) as integers.

end.description: Calendar date; year, month (1-12) and day (1-31) as integers.

costInLocalCurrency.description: BigDecimal as a decimal string, in the account currency. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

landingPageClicks.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

externalWebsiteConversions.description: long, documented default "0". Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

shares.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

reactions.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

paging.description: Optional. The documented sample carries {count, links, start} with an empty `links`, and the live Analytics Finder fallback response (2026-10-07) carried a rel=next link and no `total`. The reporting page states that adAnalytics does not support pagination; only a rel=next link in `links` is ever acted on.
